subject.title: [Feature]:Add configUrl and configButton support in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class skill configuration action, and what URL/action trust contract should the dashboard expose for skill-authored links?
rationale: The code shape is clear, but the durable decision is whether this should be arbitrary SKILL.md frontmatter, a shared Skill Card/ClawHub action model, or a deferred plugin UI extension surface; that choice affects dashboard trust boundaries and public skill metadata.

options.title: Add a typed config action
options.body: Define a narrow `metadata.openclaw` action shape with URL validation, safe default text, docs, and UI tests before rendering any clickable dashboard control.

options.title: Use existing surfaces
options.body: Keep `homepage`, Skill Cards, and ClawHub as the only supported skill links until a broader settings/action model is designed.

options.title: Defer to plugin UI extensions
options.body: Wait for a plugin-owned UI extension contract so skills and plugins can expose settings through one richer surface instead of new SKILL.md fields.

recommendation.title: Add a typed config action
recommendation.body: Define a narrow `metadata.openclaw` action shape with URL validation, safe default text, docs, and UI tests before rendering any clickable dashboard control.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans product scope, dashboard URL security, and public metadata contracts, and Peter appears in recent adjacent history for skill metadata/docs and UI URL policy.
